fuel-prices-de.ticks: insert into public.fuel_prices (observed_at, station_id, product, price, source) select current_setting('fakelive.at')::timestamptz, station_id, product, price, source from (select distinct on (station_id, product) station_id, product, price, source from public.fuel_prices where observed_at <= current_setting('fakelive.at')::timestamptz order by station_id, product, observed_at desc) newest on conflict do nothing

ags:02000000.reason: the hourly refresh cap of the area is reached

train-board-de.ticks: insert into domains.train_board_departures (eva, observed_at, planned_at, platform, category, train_number, destination) values (current_setting('fakelive.subject_key'), current_setting('fakelive.at')::timestamptz, current_setting('fakelive.at')::timestamptz + interval '12 minutes', '4', 'ICE', '578', 'Hamburg-Altona')
